about: Result of reading the whole prospectus next to the redactor's output. Only the corrections are stored: everything the redactor changed is counted as correct unless it is listed under wrongly_redacted, and every occurrence of a text listed under missed (that the redactor did not already cover) counts as missed PII.
not_pii: regulators, exchanges, depositories and government bodies (SEBI, BSE, NSE, RBI, NSDL, CDSL, ...)
newspapers named as advertising media (Financial Express, Jansatta, Loksatta)
CIN, SEBI registration, firm registration and peer-review numbers
deal, filing and certificate dates, financial figures, page and section numbers
